# Cold Email Skill for Muse

This skill writes cold outreach that reads like a sharp colleague, not a sales machine: peer-not-vendor voice, boring-looking subject lines that get opened (short, lowercase, internal-style), and frameworks like Observation → Problem → Proof → Ask, plus 3–5 touch follow-up sequences including a proper breakup email. Each touch adds something new and stands alone. Caveat: cold email is regulated (CASL, GDPR, CAN-SPAM) and lives or dies by deliverability — check your jurisdiction's rules before sending, and feed it real research signals for personalization that actually connects.
